title: The Pillar of Mirrored Quiet
summary: A school manual in which a pillar of mirrored quiet stands between the master and every hostile soul force that rises against them.

title: Manual of the Twin-Quieted Company
summary: A school manual that sets a whole company to hold the twin quiet together so that no hostile soul force reaches any of them.

title: The Azure Silence Crown
summary: A school manual of the silence that crowns the master like a clear sky and rests on the formed Core so that no soul force can pass.

title: The Gale Oath of Quiet
summary: A school manual of the oath of quiet sworn on the wind in which the master stands in the open and lets hostile soul force blow past.

title: Reckoning of the Held Stillness
summary: A school reckoning of the stillness held through a long field so that no hostile soul technique can carry the master from their bearing.

title: The Quiet Beneath the Open Wind
summary: A school manual of the quiet kept beneath the open wind with no cover at all and a stillness set upon the formed Core.
